title: FairJudge: An Adaptive, Debiased, and Consistent LLM-as-a-Judge
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of using LLMs as judges for model evaluation, specifically addressing non-semantic biases such as position, length, and format. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics; its mention of 'fairness' relates to the reduction of technical evaluation bias and its Impact Statement discussing the 'responsible use' of machine learning falls under the excluded category of brief ethical considerations.
